overview: Fossil-calibrated clocks and Early Cretaceous body fossils are kept separate: modelled crown ages do not become direct fossil first appearances or ecological dominance.

ecology.diet: Primary-producer ecology inferred from angiosperm identity; physiology is not directly preserved
ecology.habitat: Submerged freshwater setting for the sampled Montsechia material
ecology.locomotion: Sessile plant habit inferred; growth was not directly observed
ecology.bodySize: Herbaceous branching shoots in Montsechia; not a clade-wide size bound
ecology.guild: Submerged aquatic primary producer in the sampled Barremian deposits; ancestral ecology unresolved

traits: Leafy flexible axes in the sampled Montsechia material
Closed single-seeded fruits in the sampled Montsechia material
Enclosed ovule-and-fruit evidence used for angiosperm context
evidenceSummary: Clock estimates are calibration-sensitive, while Montsechia supplies specimen-level aquatic morphology; neither alone fixes the crown origin or ancestral ecology.

title.zh: Integrated analysis of fossils and molecular divergence time estimates a latest Jurassic origin of angiosperms

title.en: A metacalibrated time-tree documents the early rise of flowering plant phylogenetic diversity
title.zh: A metacalibrated time-tree documents the early rise of flowering plant phylogenetic diversity

scope.en: The selected anatomical, relationship or time-estimate material described in this account; no complete species history or distribution is inferred.
scope.zh: 用于本文选取的解剖、关系或时间估计材料，不由此推断完整物种史或分布。

text.zh: 早白垩世的 Montsechia 化石保存了带叶枝轴和封闭的单种子果实。它们展示了当时部分开花植物的样貌，却没有记录 Angiospermae 首次出现的时刻。分子钟研究则通过模型和化石校准，估算现生谱系的分支年代；这是另一条时间线。
text.en: Early Cretaceous Montsechia fossils preserve leafy axes and closed, single-seeded fruits. They show what some flowering plants were like then, not the moment Angiospermae first appeared. Molecular-clock studies estimate branching dates by applying models to living lineages and fossil calibrations, so they provide a separate timeline.

title.zh: 保存枝轴与果实的 Montsechia

text.zh: 早白垩世的 Montsechia 材料保存了柔软的带叶枝轴和封闭的单种子果实。这些是具体标本上的结构，可以用于讨论早期被子植物的形态与水生生活。它们没有记录下整个类群诞生的那一刻。
text.en: Early Cretaceous Montsechia material preserves flexible leafy axes and closed single-seeded fruits. These specimen-level structures inform discussion of early angiosperm morphology and aquatic life. They do not record the moment the whole group originated.

text.zh: 分子钟研究把现生谱系的数据与化石校准结合，估计分支发生的时间。这里的“冠群”包括某个类群全部现生成员的最近共同祖先及其后代。不同校准和分析方法会影响估计，所以冠群年代不能直接写成最早化石年代。
text.en: Molecular-clock studies combine data from living lineages with fossil calibrations to estimate branching times. A crown group includes the last common ancestor of all living members and its descendants. Calibration and analysis choices affect the estimate, so a crown age is not a first fossil occurrence.

title.zh: 起源与生态扩张的不同记录
title.en: Different records of origin and ecological expansion

text.zh: 某个年代已经存在开花植物，不等于它们当时已占据各种生态系统。一个水生化石也不能代表所有早期被子植物的祖先生态。把具体标本、模型估计和生态扩张分开，能避免用一个数字讲完一段复杂历史。
text.en: The presence of flowering plants at an age does not establish dominance across ecosystems. One aquatic fossil cannot represent the ancestral ecology of every early angiosperm. Keep specimens, model estimates and ecological expansion separate.

readerLimitations.en: Anatomical observations, interpretations of behaviour and modelled branching times answer different questions. The selected material does not identify a direct ancestor or establish a complete distribution.
readerLimitations.zh: 解剖观察、行为解释与模型中的分支时间回答不同问题。所选材料不指定直接祖先，也不建立完整分布范围。

overview: The Early Cretaceous fossil Cratolirion bognerianum preserves anatomy from roots to flowers at about 115 Ma. A morphology-matrix analysis places it within crown monocots, but does not assign it to a living family or identify the origin of the whole group.

ecology.habitat: Terrestrial Crato setting for the fossil; broad habitats in living monocots
ecology.bodySize: Herbaceous fossil; broad size range across the clade
ecology.guild: Primary producer; no single class-wide ecological guild

traits: Parallel-veined leaves occur in many monocots
Cratolirion preserves roots through reproductive organs
Crown placement comes from a morphology-matrix analysis
evidenceSummary: Cratolirion preserves extensive anatomy at a bounded fossil occurrence. Its crown placement is an analytical result, not a date for monocot origins or evidence that it belongs to one modern family.

text.en: The Early Cretaceous fossil Cratolirion bognerianum preserves anatomy from roots to flowers at about 115 Ma. A morphology-matrix analysis places it within crown monocots, but does not assign it to a living family or identify the origin of the whole group.
text.zh: 早白垩世的 Cratolirion bognerianum 化石约 115 Ma，保存了从根到花的解剖。形态矩阵分析将其置于单子叶植物冠群，但没有将它归入某个现生科，也不能据此确定整个类群的起源。

title.en: From roots to flowers in one fossil
title.zh: 一件化石保存从根到花的结构

text.en:
Many monocots have leaves with parallel veins.

*Cratolirion* preserves structures from roots to reproductive organs. Its crown-monocot placement comes from a morphology-matrix analysis.
text.zh:
许多单子叶植物具有平行脉叶。

Cratolirion 保存从根到生殖器官的结构。

冠群位置来自形态矩阵分析。

text.en: Cratolirion preserves extensive anatomy at a bounded fossil occurrence. Its crown placement is an analytical result, not a date for monocot origins or evidence that it belongs to one modern family.
text.zh: Cratolirion 在一处范围明确的化石记录中保存了丰富解剖。它的冠群位置是分析结果，不是单子叶植物起源的日期，也不证明它属于某个现生科。

title.en: Fossil evidence of core monocots in the Early Cretaceous
title.zh: Fossil evidence of core monocots in the Early Cretaceous

scope.en: Describes the Early Cretaceous Cratolirion fossil and its morphology-based crown-monocot placement; it is not assigned to a living family.
scope.zh: 描述早白垩世 Cratolirion 化石及其基于形态的单子叶植物冠群位置；研究未将它归入现生科。

title.en: A metacalibrated time-tree documents the early rise of flowering plant phylogenetic diversity
title.zh: A metacalibrated time-tree documents the early rise of flowering plant phylogenetic diversity

scope.en: A metacalibrated time-tree estimates early flowering-plant phylogenetic diversity; it does not directly date the Cratolirion occurrence.
scope.zh: 元校准时间树估计早期被子植物系统发育多样性；它不直接确定 Cratolirion 化石记录年代。

traitsZh: 许多单子叶植物具有平行脉叶。
Cratolirion 保存了从根部到生殖器官的多个部位。
冠群中的位置来自形态矩阵分析。

geography: Lameta Formation coprolite phytolith assemblage, central India
overview: Grass history comes from evidence at different scales: phytoliths in latest-Cretaceous coprolites from India, later phytolith assemblages in Great Plains soils, and a sampled plastid family tree. A coprolite can preserve what passed through an animal; soil assemblages track vegetation at a regional scale; a tree models relationships among sampled lineages. None alone supplies one grass-origin date, a universal C4 history or a global grassland narrative.
overviewZh: 禾本科历史来自不同尺度的证据：印度最晚白垩世粪化石中的植硅体、后来大平原土壤中的植硅体组合，以及采样的叶绿体基因家族树。粪化石可以保存动物取食后留下的颗粒，土壤组合反映区域植被，基因树则模拟被采样谱系之间的关系。任何一条证据都不能单独给出统一的禾本科起源日期、普遍的 C4 演化史或全球草原叙事。

ecology.diet: Grasses are photosynthetic primary producers. The fossil samples do not establish one ecological role for every member of the family.
ecology.habitat: The Great Plains palaeosols record heterogeneous mixtures of C3 and C4 vegetation in the sampled region, not a single global grass habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Grass plants grow in place; this biological description does not identify the vegetation structure represented by any one phytolith sample.
ecology.bodySize: Phytolith assemblages do not yield a family-wide body-size range.
ecology.guild: The evidence supports the primary-producer role of grasses. C4 biomass in a sample does not by itself show that open grassland dominated the landscape.
ecology.habitatZh: 大平原地区的古土壤记录显示，取样区域内 C3 与 C4 植被混杂分布；这并不代表全球草类只有一种生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 禾本科植物在原地生长；这一生物学描述不能确定任何单个植硅体样本所代表的植被结构。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 植硅体组合无法给出全科范围的体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 证据支持禾草发挥初级生产者作用。样本中的 C4 生物量本身并不能证明开阔草原曾主导整个景观。

traits: The Lameta coprolites contain phytolith shapes that the cited study identifies as diagnostic of grasses; this microscopic evidence is tied to those specimens and their locality.
Great Plains samples include chloridoid and other short-cell phytoliths considered potentially C4 PACMAD grasses; the assignment describes the sampled assemblages.
On the sampled plastid tree, C4 photosynthesis is reconstructed as arising more than once rather than as a single family-wide innovation.
evidenceSummary: Prasad and colleagues describe a disputed phytolith assemblage from a particular Lameta locality; Strömberg and McInerney quantify a later regional change in Great Plains soils; GPWG II reconstructs multiple C4 origins on a sampled plastid tree. Together, these studies do not establish a body-fossil first appearance, a crown age or global vegetation cover.
evidenceSummaryZh: Prasad 等人描述了 Lameta 一处地点的植硅体组合，其解释仍有争议；Strömberg 与 McInerney 量化了大平原土壤中较晚时期的区域变化；GPWG II 在采样的叶绿体基因树上重建出多次 C4 起源。三项研究合起来仍不能确定身体化石的首次出现、冠群年龄或全球植被覆盖。

readerLimitations.en: The profile joins three evidence scales: a disputed phytolith assemblage in one Lameta coprolite sample, regional Great Plains soils and a sampled plastid tree. Together they do not establish a body-fossil first appearance, a single C4 origin or global grassland dominance.
readerLimitations.zh: 本档案并列三种证据尺度：Lameta 一处粪化石样本中仍有争议的植硅体组合、大平原区域土壤记录，以及采样的质体系统树。它们合起来仍不能确立禾本科实体化石首现、单次 C4 起源或全球草原占主导。

traitsZh: Lameta 粪化石中含有植硅体形态，所引研究将其鉴定为禾本科的诊断性形态；这类显微证据仅对应这些标本及其产地。
大平原样品包括虎尾草亚科型及其他短细胞植硅体；这些被视为可能来自 C4 型 PACMAD 禾草。该归属描述的是所取样的组合。
在所取样的质体系统树上，C4 光合作用被重建为多次独立起源，而非禾本科全科共有的一次创新。

overview: Two lines of evidence meet in Fabaceae: a 65.35 Ma fruit and leaflets from Corral Bluffs, and a broad phylogeny that revises the classification of living legumes into six subfamilies. They answer different questions about the family.

ecology.diet: Photosynthetic primary-producer identity inferred from family membership; the Corral Bluffs fruit and leaflets do not directly recover a family-wide ecology
ecology.habitat: Corral Bluffs fossil locality only; no family-wide habitat is assigned
ecology.bodySize: Fruit and leaflet evidence only; no family-wide size range is assigned
ecology.guild: Primary-producer context only; fossil morphology does not establish a family-wide guild

traits: A dated Corral Bluffs fruit and associated leaflets assigned to Fabaceae
Six-subfamily classification supported by a taxonomically broad phylogeny
Fossil family presence kept separate from subfamily assignment and crown-age inference
evidenceSummary: The Corral Bluffs fossils support a family-level occurrence, not a subfamily assignment or crown age. The living-family phylogeny revises classification but does not identify the fossil’s placement, a family origin centre or continuous global occupancy.

title.zh: 化石记录的是科级出现

text.en: A fruit and associated leaflets from Corral Bluffs in Colorado are assigned to Fabaceae and dated to 65.35 Ma. These preserved plant parts make a bounded fossil record for the family. They do not assign the specimen to one of the living subfamilies, set the family’s crown age, or show where Fabaceae first originated.
text.zh: 科罗拉多州 Corral Bluffs 的一枚果实及相关小叶被归入豆科，年代为 65.35 Ma。这些保存下来的植物结构构成豆科的一项有界化石记录，却没有把标本归入现生某个亚科，也不能确定该科冠群的年龄或起源地点。

title.zh: 系统发育研究重整现生豆科分类

text.en: The Legume Phylogeny Working Group assembled broad taxonomic sampling to support six subfamilies and replace the traditional, broadly defined Caesalpinioideae arrangement. This is a classification of sampled living legumes. It does not place the Corral Bluffs fossil in a subfamily, date the family’s origin or turn the fossil into an ancestor of modern plants.
text.zh: 豆科系统发育工作组通过较广的分类取样支持六个亚科，并取代传统宽泛的 Caesalpinioideae 分类框架。这是对纳入研究的现生豆科植物的分类，不会把 Corral Bluffs 化石归入某个亚科、确定豆科起源年代，或把化石认作现代植物的祖先。

overviewZh: 豆科的两类证据在此并列：一枚距今 6535 万年的果实及来自 Corral Bluffs 的小叶，以及一项将现生豆科分类修订为六个亚科的大型系统发育研究。它们回答的是有关该科的不同问题。
